outputs.explanation: The only significance symbol used (**) is defined directly on the image/graph area of panel A as '**p<0.01' along with sample size information (N=4, n>100).

Both asterisk symbols used on the line plot are explicitly defined directly on the image ('* p<0.05' and '** p<0.01'), with color/text cues indicating which pairwise comparison (KI vs KI/HMGB1, or KI vs WT) each refers to.

The asterisk symbol used in panel E's line plots corresponds to the same '* p<0.05' convention explicitly defined elsewhere on this composite figure (in panel D), so a usable definition for the symbol exists on the image.
The plot reports an exact log-rank test p-value (P = 0.0025) directly on the image, which is inherently self-explanatory and requires no additional legend.
